fn_store_kpi()
| where window_start >= ago(1d)
| summarize
    total_visitors = sum(group_visitor_count),
    total_txns = sum(transaction_count)
| extend ConversionRate = iff(total_visitors == 0, "0%",
    strcat(tostring(round(todouble(total_txns) / todouble(total_visitors) * 100.0, 1)), "%"))
| project ConversionRate

let _now = now();
fn_entries_exits_24h()
| where window_start >= _now - 24h and window_start <= _now
| summarize
    Entries = sum(entries),
    Exits = sum(exits)
    by bin(window_start, 15m)
| order by window_start asc
| project ts = window_start, Entries, Exits

fn_store_kpi()
| where window_start >= ago(1d)
| project window_start, group_visitor_count, revenue_amount
| order by window_start asc

let _now = now() - 5h;
officeCam
| where ts >= _now - 7d and ts <= _now and event_type == "PERSON_ENTERED"
| extend DayOfWeek = case(
    dayofweek(ts) == time(0:00:00), "0-Sun",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(1.00:00:00), "1-Mon",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(2.00:00:00), "2-Tue",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(3.00:00:00), "3-Wed",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(4.00:00:00), "4-Thu",
    dayofweek(ts) == time(5.00:00:00), "5-Fri",
    "6-Sat")
| extend Hour = tostring(datetime_part("hour", ts))
| summarize Visitors = count() by DayOfWeek, Hour
| order by DayOfWeek asc, Hour asc

let _now = now();
fn_avg_dwell_by_hour()
| where window_start >= _now - 7d and window_start <= _now
| summarize AvgDwellMinutes = round(avg(avg_dwell_seconds) / 60, 1) 
    by Hour = hour_of_day
| order by Hour asc

fn_store_kpi()
| where window_start >= ago(1d)
| summarize
    total_revenue = sum(revenue_amount),
    total_visitors = sum(group_visitor_count)
| extend RevenuePerVisitor = iff(total_visitors == 0, 0.0,
    round(total_revenue / todouble(total_visitors), 2))
| project RevenuePerVisitor

fn_zone_kpi()
| summarize avg_rate = round(avg(dwell_to_conversion_rate) * 100, 1)
    by zone_id
| project zone_id, avg_rate
